error_category_mapping.diagnostic_sentence: If the square root of 49 is not recalled as 7, the next link is square-root facts rather than the quadratic formula itself. Discriminant work relies on this recall.

hint_ladder.title: Root meaning
hint_ladder.prompt: A square root asks which positive number squares to make 49.

hint_ladder.title: Test the base
hint_ladder.prompt: Check nearby square facts and ask which base number makes 49 when squared. Do not treat the root as halving.

hint_ladder.title: Do not halve
hint_ladder.prompt: A common slip is treating square root like dividing by 2. It is the inverse of squaring, not halving.

hint_ladder.title: Root routine
hint_ladder.prompt: For a square root, ask which number multiplied by itself gives the value. Apply that to 49; do not copy.

expected_solution_steps.diagnostic_sentence: This repair focuses on connecting a square number to its base number, not performing a new algebraic method.
